record.title: incident retro for phishing wave
record.summary: The incident retro for the phishing wave from last week began with a timeline: the first reported click was at 09:14, and the first containment action occurred at 09:52, totaling thirty-eight minutes. Marcus identified a process gap where eleven of the incidents were delayed due to him being in a meeting, highlighting the need for a documented escalation process that does not rely on a single person. Dana agreed and noted this as finding one. Marcus committed to drafting the escalation runbook, with a deadline of 2026-08-09. Priya reported that 214 users received the email, 9 clicked, and 3 entered credentials, all of which were reset within an hour with no successful logins from attacker infrastructure. Rio noted that all credential entries occurred on a fake AD FS page, reiterating the ongoing lack of phishing-resistant MFA enforcement for the finance group, due to an exemption from the ERP migration still in place two years later. Dana asked if removing the exemption would be disruptive, and Rio confirmed that the ERP vendor now supports FIDO keys from their March release, making it a simple config change and comms plan. Dana noted this as finding two, with Rio owning the removal. Rio proposed staging the change with a pilot of five finance users next week, followed by rollout to the rest of the group. Priya confirmed that the phishing domains are already in the blocklist feed and that the takedown request was sent to the registrar an hour ago. Dana noted that the fake page was live for six hours before the first report, and that a canary token in the login footer template would have detected the clone at hour zero, which is a low-cost solution. Dana categorized this as finding three with no owner, to be placed in the backlog. Marcus added a process note that users who reported the incident received no acknowledgment, and two re-reported thinking it was lost, which would be resolved by adding auto-ack on the report button. Dana added this to the backlog as well. The summary of decisions and commitments is: Marcus will complete the escalation runbook by 2026-08-09, Rio will remove the MFA exemption in a staged pilot starting next week, Priya will complete the blocklist and takedown, and the canary tokens and auto-ack features will be added to the backlog.
